scope: Seven advanced DOE operations, no GUI. Sylvester Hadamard main-effect screening is not general Plackett-Burman or definitive screening; generator factorials do not infer alias resolution or optimality.
layer: Independent NumPy oracle uses isolated Rust advanced_design::run; final Rust integration tests use public execute routing; SQL/native validation is parent-owned.

regression.name: mixture_sum_tolerance_respects_small_measurement_units
regression.red: fixed mixture lower total2e-15 was accepted against requested total1e-100 because tolerance used max(total,1)
regression.green: Relative tolerance (64*epsilon*factors)*total rejects impossible mixtures and preserves valid tiny-unit simplex lattices

box_behnken.construction: four sign combinations for every factor pair; remaining factors centered

latin_hypercube.construction: one independently shuffled, uniformly jittered sample per stratum per factor

mixture_lattice.data: nonnegative [lower,upper] rows; fixed components lower=upper allowed
mixture_lattice.construction: lower_i+(total-sum(lower))*count_i/degree, all nonnegative integer compositions of degree, filter upper constraints; degenerate remaining total yields one point

fractional_factorial.args: [base_count,center_points,generator_masks...] exact one mask per remaining factor
fractional_factorial.construction: base columns enumerate all2^base corners; generated columns are positive products of selected base columns

orthogonal_screening.construction: first p nonconstant Sylvester Hadamard columns, run_count next_power_of_two(p+1)

randomize_design.data: arbitrary finite numeric rectangular design matrix
randomize_design.construction: independent complete shuffle per replicate, then consecutive equal-size blocks; input row count divisible by blocks; labels/sourceindices zero-based

design_evaluate.construction: intercept added; twice reorthogonalized QR on origin-relative mean-centered populationRMS-scaled terms; raw and coded information/inverse/logdet both returned; spectral2norm condition is coded design matrix; leverages from Q

limits.rank_rule: QRrelative residualnorm<=1e-10 rejects; coded spectral eigenvalue ratio<=1e-14 rejects as unreliable

harness.reproduction: Restore lib_rs to lib.rs, runner_rs to design_runner.rs, oracle_py to design_verify.py under build_directory. Compile with rustc --edition 2021 --crate-name ducksmiles_analytics --crate-type rlib lib.rs -o libducksmiles_analytics.rlib; rustc --edition 2021 design_runner.rs --extern ducksmiles_analytics=<build_directory>/libducksmiles_analytics.rlib -o design_runner. Run python3 design_verify.py. No runtime dependencies added to production.
